{{Tabs|History = No}} {{SameName|Giant Skeleton|[[Giant Skeleton (Unit)|Unit]] • [[Giant Skeleton (Lunar Overture)|Lunar Overture]] • [[Giant Skeleton|Badlands II]]}} {{For|other uses of [[Skeleton (Disambiguation)|Skeleton]]}} {{UnitInfobox |title1 = Giant Skeleton |image-static = GiantSkeletonLunar.png |image-dynamic = GiantSkeletonDynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Necromancer]]
[[Necromancer's Tome (Consumable)|Necromancer's Tome]] |type= Humanoid |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]1,200 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]2 |damage_type = Collision |speed = 3.5 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Giant Skeleton''' is a unit spawned from the [[Necromancer]]'s Level 1 and 2 gravestones and randomly from dead enemies while the [[Necromancer's Tome (Consumable)|Necromancer's Tome]] consumable is active. It is a larger version of the [[Skeleton (Unit)|Skeleton]] unit with higher health, though is considerably slower. It only deals damage through collision. ==Appearance== The '''Giant Skeleton''' is made entirely of white parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid. It does not have a full torso, but instead has the bone cage for it. Its head is slightly smaller than normal and has two large black eyeholes. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:MageGiantSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:FallenGiantSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:DuckGiantSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:CreepySantaGiantSkeleton.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Deluxe|Mage}} |{{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} |{{Color|DuckyRevenge|Duck}} |{{Color|FinalAct|Creepy Santa}} |- !Obtained From |[[Deluxe Crate]] |[[Mission Quests]] |[[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Premium Battle Pass]] |[[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Regular Battle Pass]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Giant Skeleton's''' high health allows it to handle higher health enemies, like the [[Molten]] or [[Necromancer]], quite well. **It is also quite effective against hordes of enemies with lower health, like the [[Shadow]] or [[Heavy]]. *The '''Giant Skeleton''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Heavy]] or [[Abnormal Boss]]. *The '''Giant Skeleton''' will struggle against most enemies with abilities that damage units, as most of them deal more damage than it has health. **For example, if the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] uses its ''Stomp'' attack, and a '''Giant Skeleton''' is caught in the attack, it will lose most of its health. ==Trivia== *The '''Giant Skeleton''' is based on the [[Giant Skeleton]] enemy from the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''31 October 2023''' -
